label: Protection
blurb: Existing conservation and management measures: marine protected areas, no-take areas and bottom-fishing closures.

headlines.label: Provisional protection score
headlines.note: The score is the mean of this pillar's variable percentiles among EBSAs, from 0 to 100.

charts.title: Percentile by variable
charts.subtitle: Percentiles run from 0 to 100 among all EBSAs, and higher is better for the pillar.

charts.title: Distribution across EBSAs
charts.subtitle: The dot marks this EBSA's value on the spread of all EBSAs.
charts.label: label

method: Shares are the area of the EBSA's res-6 cells that touch a marine or coastal protected area in the WDPA (status other than Proposed), a fully no-take protected area (NO_TAKE = All), or an FAO bottom-fishing closure for vulnerable marine ecosystems, divided by the EBSA's area. A cell counts if any part of it is covered, so shares are upper bounds for small sites. More existing protection scores higher (BBNJ Annex I criterion v). For a gap analysis, reverse the pillar's variables in the scoring panel. Scores are mid-rank percentiles (0–100) among the EBSAs with data, with direction applied so higher is better for the pillar; tied values share the midpoint of their rank range. The pillar score is the plain mean of the variable percentiles. All of this is provisional.
